gaps.explanation: bring down = cause a government/person to lose power; reduce (prices).

gaps.sentence: She's been going ___ a difficult time at work.
The plane will drop ___ the parcels at the next farm.
gaps.explanation: drop off = deliver somebody/something; also become less (sales dropped off).

gaps.sentence: The old buses are being phased ___ next year.
gaps.explanation: phase out = stop using something gradually.

gaps.sentence: The evidence finally backed ___ his version of events.
gaps.explanation: back up = support with evidence (a claim backs up a story).

gaps.sentence: I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.
Hold ___ a moment — I'll check if he's in.
gaps.explanation: hold on = wait (especially on the phone).
